title:
(1) Air Force Special Security Office Report, Northeast Air Command: UFOB NEAC Area. July 18, 1955
(2) Air Intelligence Information Report: Unidentified Flying Object Report, March 18, 1956
doc_notes: This collection contains multiple archival reports from the Air Force and other agencies documenting radar and visual encounters with unidentified aerial objects.

encounters.summary: RB-47 crew reported visual contact with a glistening silver metallic aircraft low and to the rear of their position; radar contact also maintained for 9 minutes.
RB-47 crew reported visual contact with an aircraft of fighter configuration 5-10 miles behind them; radar contact also recorded.
KC-97 crews and radar site reported multiple objects, one hovering then accelerating to 1600 knots, others moving in circular patterns at high speeds.
encounters.entity_behavior: hovering, erratic zig-zag, high speed acceleration, circular patterns
encounters.quote: making a very irregular zig zag pattern

encounters.summary: Radar sites tracked unidentified objects exhibiting erratic, triangular flight patterns and evasive maneuvers; visual reports of red and green lights.
encounters.quote: returns were strong and easily distinguished from cloud formations

encounters.summary: RC-135 crew observed a bright white light appearing as a giant pinwheel that rose in altitude and grew brighter before disappearing.
encounters.entity_behavior: rose in altitude, grew brighter, went out
encounters.quote: appeared as a giant pinwheel in a fireworks display
